title: RRB NTPC Graduate Recruitment 2026: 3,548 Posts Online Form
course: Station Master, Goods Train Manager, Junior Account Assistant
qualification: Graduate in any discipline from a recognized University
short_info: Railway Recruitment Board (RRB) has released the official notification for 3,548 NTPC Graduate Level vacancies. Eligible graduates can apply online before 30 November 2026.
dates_text:
Application Starts: 01 Nov 2026
Last Date to Apply: 30 Nov 2026
Fee Payment Last Date: 02 Dec 2026
CBT-1 Exam Date: 15 Feb 2027
fees:
General / OBC / EWS: Rs. 500 (Rs. 400 refundable)
SC / ST / Female / EBC: Rs. 250 (Full refundable)
age_limit:
Minimum Age: 18 Years
Maximum Age: 36 Years
Age relaxation for OBC (3 yrs) & SC/ST (5 yrs)
eligibility:
Bachelor Degree in any stream from a recognized University.
Typing skill required for Clerk / Typist posts.
how_to_apply:
Visit myadmissionguru.com and open RRB NTPC Graduate 2026 page.
Click on Apply Online link and complete OTR registration.
Upload photo, signature, pay fee online and print confirmation.
